info.name: Kintsugi Tax Address Validation Transactions API

description.content:
REST API for the Kintsugi AI sales tax compliance and automation platform. Calculate US sales tax, VAT, and GST; sync transactions, products, and customers; validate addresses; manage physical nexus, exemptions, and registrations; and retrieve automated filings. Authentication uses an API key supplied in the x-api-key header together with the x-organization-id header identifying the organization. Endpoints, fields, and schemas in this document reflect Kintsugi's public API reference at docs.trykintsugi.com and are not exhaustive; consult the provider documentation for the authoritative contract.
